name: Child's Pose (Balasana)
description: A restful pose that gently stretches the hips, thighs, and ankles.
instructions: Kneel on the floor. Sit back on heels, fold torso forward, extend arms overhead on floor. Rest forehead down. Breathe deeply.
benefits: Releases tension in lower back, promotes relaxation, calms the mind.

name: Mountain Pose (Tadasana)
description: The foundation of all standing poses, improving posture and body awareness.
instructions: Stand with feet together, weight evenly distributed. Lift chest, roll shoulders back. Arms alongside body, palms forward. Breathe evenly.
benefits: Improves posture, strengthens thighs and ankles, increases body awareness.

name: Downward-Facing Dog (Adho Mukha Svanasana)
description: An inverted V-shape pose that stretches and strengthens the entire body.
instructions: Start on hands and knees. Lift hips, straighten legs, press heels toward floor. Spread fingers wide. Keep back flat.
benefits: Stretches hamstrings, calves, shoulders. Strengthens arms and legs. Energizing.

name: Warrior I (Virabhadrasana I)
description: Powerful standing pose building leg strength and hip flexibility.
instructions: Step right foot forward, bend knee to 90°. Left foot angled back. Raise arms overhead. Square hips forward. Hold, then switch.
benefits: Strengthens legs and core, opens hips and chest, improves balance.

name: Warrior II (Virabhadrasana II)
description: Wide-legged stance with arms extended, building endurance and focus.
instructions: Wide stance, right knee bent over ankle. Arms parallel to floor. Gaze over front hand. Engage core. Switch sides.
benefits: Strengthens legs, opens groin and chest, improves concentration.

name: Tree Pose (Vrikshasana)
description: Single-leg balance pose improving focus, coordination, and stability.
instructions: Stand on left leg. Place right foot on inner thigh or calf (not knee). Bring palms together. Fix gaze ahead. Hold, then switch.
benefits: Improves balance and concentration, strengthens ankles and calves.

name: Cat-Cow Stretch (Marjaryasana-Bitilasana)
description: Gentle flowing movement between two spinal positions to improve back flexibility.
instructions: On hands and knees, alternate between arching back (cow) and rounding back (cat). Sync with breath. 10 slow cycles.
benefits: Relieves back tension, improves spinal flexibility, great for lower back pain.

name: Cobra Pose (Bhujangasana)
description: Back-bending pose that opens the chest and strengthens the spine.
instructions: Lie prone. Place palms under shoulders. Lift chest using back muscles (not arm push). Keep pelvis on floor. Hold.
benefits: Strengthens spine, opens chest and lungs, reduces stress and fatigue.

name: Seated Forward Bend (Paschimottanasana)
description: Forward fold that deeply stretches the hamstrings and calms the mind.
instructions: Sit with legs extended. Inhale to lengthen spine, exhale and fold forward from hips. Hold feet or shins. Breathe into the stretch.
benefits: Stretches spine, hamstrings, shoulders. Reduces anxiety. Stimulates digestion.

name: Legs Up the Wall (Viparita Karani)
description: Restorative pose with legs elevated against wall, excellent for recovery.
instructions: Sit close to wall, swing legs up. Rest with back flat on floor. Relax arms by sides. Breathe deeply for 5 minutes.
benefits: Reduces swelling in legs, promotes relaxation, improves circulation, great for menstrual discomfort.

name: Bridge Pose (Setu Bandha Sarvangasana)
description: Supine back-bending pose strengthening glutes and opening the chest.
instructions: Lie on back, knees bent, feet flat. Press feet into floor and lift hips. Clasp hands beneath body. Hold, then lower slowly.
benefits: Strengthens glutes and hamstrings, opens chest and hips, improves spinal flexibility.

name: Triangle Pose (Trikonasana)
description: Lateral bending pose stretching the sides of the body and strengthening legs.
instructions: Wide stance, right foot forward. Extend arms. Hinge right hand toward shin/floor, left arm to ceiling. Hold, switch.
benefits: Stretches groins, hamstrings, chest. Strengthens ankles and calves. Improves digestion.

name: Pigeon Pose (Eka Pada Rajakapotasana)
description: Deep hip-opener that releases tension from tight hip flexors.
instructions: From downward dog, bring right knee behind right wrist. Extend left leg back. Lower to elbows or forehead. Breathe deeply. Switch.
benefits: Deep hip flexor release, reduces sciatica, excellent for those who sit for long periods.

name: Boat Pose (Navasana)
description: Core-intensive pose balancing on sitting bones with legs and torso elevated.
instructions: Sit on floor, lean back slightly, lift legs to 45°. Arms parallel to floor. Engage core. Hold for 30 seconds, 3 repetitions.
benefits: Strengthens core, hip flexors, and spine. Improves balance and digestion.

name: Chair Pose (Utkatasana)
description: Standing squat-like pose that builds leg strength and endurance.
instructions: From mountain pose, bend knees as if sitting in chair. Raise arms overhead. Keep knees together, weight in heels. Hold.
benefits: Strengthens thighs, calves, spine. Stimulates diaphragm and heart. Builds endurance.

name: Supta Baddha Konasana (Reclining Butterfly)
description: Restorative reclining pose that opens hips and inner thighs gently.
instructions: Lie on back, bring soles of feet together, let knees fall open. Support with blankets if needed. Relax for 5 minutes.
benefits: Opens inner thighs and groin, reduces menstrual discomfort, deeply relaxing.

name: Sun Salutation (Surya Namaskar)
description: A flowing sequence of 12 poses performed as a morning practice or warmup.
instructions: 5 complete rounds. Synchronize movement with breath. Mountain pose → overhead stretch → forward fold → plank → cobra → downward dog → forward fold → rise.
benefits: Full body stretch and strengthening, improves circulation, great for morning energy.

name: Corpse Pose (Savasana)
description: Complete relaxation pose performed at the end of every yoga session.
instructions: Lie flat on back, legs slightly apart, arms at sides palms up. Close eyes. Consciously relax each body part. 10 minutes.
benefits: Complete mental and physical relaxation, reduces stress, improves sleep quality.

name: Seated Spinal Twist (Ardha Matsyendrasana)
description: Seated twist that massages abdominal organs and improves spinal rotation.
instructions: Sit with legs extended. Bend right knee, foot beside left thigh. Twist right, left elbow on right knee. Hold, breathe, switch.
benefits: Improves spinal mobility, stimulates digestion, detoxifies the body.

name: Pranayama (Alternate Nostril Breathing)
description: Breathing technique balancing left and right brain hemispheres.
instructions: Close right nostril with thumb. Inhale left 4 counts. Close left with ring finger. Open right. Exhale 4 counts. Repeat 10 cycles.
benefits: Reduces stress and anxiety, improves focus, balances nervous system.

name: Happy Baby Pose (Ananda Balasana)
description: Playful supine pose releasing lower back and inner groin.
instructions: Lie on back. Bring knees to chest. Hold outer edges of feet, flex feet. Open knees wide. Rock gently side to side.
benefits: Releases lower back, opens inner groins, calms the nervous system.

name: Low Lunge (Anjaneyasana)
description: Hip-flexor-opening lunge posture, excellent for those with tight hips.
instructions: Step right foot forward, lower left knee to floor. Sink hips forward and down. Raise arms overhead. Hold 30 seconds, switch.
benefits: Opens hip flexors, stretches quads, strengthens legs and core.
